summary: First test run on ToolShare MVP. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases passed covering health, auth (register/login/me), tools (list/filter/distance/get/create), upload, full booking flow (create→approve→review→rating update), favorites, and AI recommend. Frontend: Landing, Browse (12 tools + map + view toggles + filters), Tool Detail (gallery, owner card, booking calendar), Login (seeded user → dashboard), Register (new user → dashboard), Dashboard (all 4 tabs visible), and AI Assistant (task input → structured results) all work as expected with no functional issues.

issues: Multiple 401 responses logged in browser console from /api/auth/me probe calls when user is unauthenticated. Functionally harmless (auth context expects this), but pollutes the console. Consider skipping the /auth/me call when no token is present in localStorage, or treat 401 silently in the API client to keep the console clean.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress /api/auth/me 401 console noise on public pages by gating the call on presence of toolshare_token in localStorage.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~950 lines — consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/tools.py, routers/bookings.py, routers/ai.py, services/storage.py for maintainability (file size > 700 lines).
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in newer FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager.
ai_recommend endpoint is unauthenticated — consider rate-limiting or requiring auth since it calls a paid LLM and could be abused.
GET /api/tools/{id} increments view_count on every fetch including the owner's own visits and bots; consider de-duplicating by session/user.
create_booking does not check for overlapping bookings on the same tool/date-range, nor against tool.unavailable_dates — possible double-booking.
Review creation does not enforce that the booking is in a completable state (e.g., status='completed') nor prevent duplicate reviews from the same reviewer for the same booking/target.
Favorites endpoint has no auth check on the tool_id existence — a user can favorite a non-existent tool id.
CORS uses allow_origin_regex='https?://.*' which is effectively open; acceptable for preview but tighten before production.
test_credentials: marcus@toolshare.demo / demo1234 (verified working); sara@toolshare.demo / demo1234 (verified working)
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed (3 users + 12 tools). Test pytest creates ephemeral tool listings & bookings (cleaned up where possible). New user registrations from frontend test created two test_*@toolshare.demo accounts in DB — these are inert and can be ignored or cleaned manually.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all critical endpoints; rerun with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Frontend uses data-testids extensively: register-name/register-email/register-password, browse-search-input/browse-category-select/browse-city-input, view-split/grid/map, tool-card-{id}, booking-calendar, request-booking-btn, ai-task-input/ai-submit-btn/ai-results. Auth uses JWT in localStorage key 'toolshare_token' with Authorization: Bearer header. AI endpoint can take ~5-10s; allow 60-90s timeout.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs were found in this iteration.
